header.note: Translation of informal settlements definition text — English to French.

trans-unit.source: Globally there are different terms and definitions of informal settlements, often based on the lens of the legal, spatial, infrastructural, or socio-economic conditions.
trans-unit.target: À l'échelle mondiale, il existe différents termes et définitions des établissements informels, souvent fondés sur le prisme des conditions juridiques, spatiales, infrastructurelles ou socio-économiques.
trans-unit.note: "Informal settlements" rendered as "établissements informels" (standard French urban planning term). "Lens" rendered idiomatically as "prisme" (prism/lens) rather than a literal translation.
